summary: The agent followed up on a proposal and discussed pricing after the prospect said their budget was tight. The agent offered a special 30% discount for signing within the week, which the prospect accepted and requested the contract by the next day. The prospect also asked about a new analytics dashboard shipping by Q1, and the agent said they could not guarantee it but would forward the request to product.
